tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /shes dkar rdzong dpon dga' bo por gnang ba'i spring yig bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa ya/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka'/ /bslu med thugs rje'i gter chen dkon mchog lung / /drag shugs mthu ldan chos skyong srung ma'i tshig /ku sa la yi rnal 'byor bden pa'i gtam/ /nam mkha' bar snang sa steng sa bla dang / /sa 'og rgyu ba'i lha srin sde brgyad tshogs/ /spyi dang khyad par sbyin pa'i bdag po yi/ /lus ngag sems la gnod 'tshe byed pa'i gdon/ /tshe sngon lan chags bu lon ma 'khyer zhing / /dus 'dir bya spyod phran tshegs nyes tsam la/ /gnod sems gdug pa'i bsam sbyor kun bslangs nas/ /lus la nad dang sems la duḥkha dag /skyed byed ma rungs tshogs nas nges dgos rgyu/ /mi 'jigs 'jig rten mgon po nyi ma'i gnyen/ /skyob pa shākya'i rgyal po'i bka' lung ltar/ /spyir gyi mkha' mnyam 'gro la gnod sems spongs/ /khyad par dam ldan sbyin bdag 'khor bcas la/ /dus 'di nas bzung byang chen ma thob par/ /skye zhing skye bar tshe rabs thams cad du/ /mi min 'gro ba gnod sems ldan rnams kyis/ /gnod sems spongs la zhi ba byang chub sems/ /ches cher bskyed nas tshe bsod dpal 'byor sogs/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas pa'i grogs dan gyis/ /bod yul lha gcig phyag na pad dkar gyi/ /thugs rje'i chab kyis gdon bgegs gnod sems med/ /zhi nas byang sems chu rgyun cher rgyas nas/ gnod byed gnod yul kun kyang dge bcu yi/ /dpal la spyod pa'i bden tshig 'grub par smon/ /zhes 'di 'phags pa'i yul nas byang phyogs su/ /dpag tshad brgya phrag bgrod pa'i sa yi cha/ /sa 'dzin gnyis 'thung nyal 'dra'i gnas kyi mchog /rdo rje 'chang dngos mkhas grub bsti ba'i gnas/ /chos grwa chen po dpal ldan sa skya zhes/ /yon tan rin chen 'byung ba'i sgo gcig pu/ /ngo mtshar gnas mchog gang de na gnas pa'i/

/ngag la dbang bsgyur ngur smrig bla gos can/ /kun dga'i ming 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa gang / /blo gros cher gsal mkhas mang dga' ba'i gnyen/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin byed pa/ /dpal ldan bzang pos smras pa dge bar gyur// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ rta mgrin yang gsang gi dkyil 'khor chen por slob ma rjes 'dzin dbang gi PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
